html:
SMTO-WEB-0043 — Research completion correction failed

GUID: a33ec4a5-6e09-58af-914c-1a12ffd50c12
Slug: research-completion-repair-protocol-failure
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web_research

What happened

  • SMTO's attempt to fix its research answer didn't produce a usable result, so it stopped trying. The work it already did is kept, and its answer may be marked as partial.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Read SMTO's answer and look for a note saying it is partial or which points it couldn't confirm. SMTO stopped correcting itself, so the answer shows exactly how far it got.
  2. Treat any point SMTO couldn't confirm as unchecked until you compare it with a source you trust. The failed correction means those statements were never matched to a page SMTO read.
  3. If you need more, send a new message asking SMTO to check again, naming the websites or links to use. A new request starts fresh, and named sources give SMTO a clear way to back up each point.

What success looks like

  • The new answer lists its sources for each point, or clearly says which parts it couldn't confirm.

If it still fails

  • If this happens again on the new request, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't treat the partial answer as fully checked.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A research completion correction ended without a valid finish action: the repair response contained no tool call, or repeated research completion rejections without progress reached the protocol retry limit.

What this means

  • The single research-repair response contains no native tool calls, so the required completion correction cannot proceed. The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.

Why this can happen

  • The single research-repair response contains no native tool calls, so the required completion correction cannot proceed.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the repair response and original completion rejection; distinguish missing calls from invalid control protocols.

How to fix it

  • Inspect completion.protocol_retry events and completion_recovery.rejections for the last research_* rejection reason; native.recovery.protocol_miss() leaves the run partial at PROTOCOL_MISS_LIMIT. Address the original rejection (missing sources, required Browser, PDF lineage) in a new turn with retained evidence; no further automatic correction is permitted, and the malformed correction must not be treated as a verified answer.
  • Retain verified evidence and report the original completion rejection. No further correction is permitted.

Retry and execution caution

  • Retain verified evidence and report the original completion rejection. No further correction is permitted.

How to verify the fix

  • Retained work is preserved with its original verification limit after the bounded repair ends.

What not to do

  • Do not treat a malformed completion correction as a verified final research answer.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
